name: 78744 · Austin, TX
findings: ZIP 78744 (Austin) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78744 (Austin) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
